sections.heading: G — Definition of done
sections.markdown:
## G — Definition of done

This matrix disposes every Definition-of-Done box for the required and prohibited vehicle equipment, the periodic safety inspection, and the condition and maintenance checks for brakes, lamps, signals, exhaust, steering, tires, belts and windshields section; each entry names its box, disposition and evidence location.

Knowledge boxes resolve to the accepted part C chunk (ranked high-yield list, misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines); KG-hint boxes ride with the accepted part C-two chunk.

Market boxes resolve to the accepted parts E and E-two scoped statements; accuracy resolves to part D and the consolidated VERIFY list to part F.

The passing-standard box is not applicable: the manual states no passing standard, and part A records that official fact as terminal unknown rather than as pending verification.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the required and prohibited vehicle equipment, the periodic safety inspection, and the condition and maintenance checks for brakes, lamps, signals, exhaust, steering, tires, belts and windshields rules on pages 18–20 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
